items.title: Darboe Says Barrow’s Call for Continuity Means More Corruption, Hardship, and Broken Promises
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe United Democratic Party (UDP) leader Ousainu Darboe has urged residents of Dippa Kunda to reject President Adama Barrow’s call for continuity, arguing that another term under the incumbent would mean continued corruption, economic hardship, and unfulfilled promis...
items.author: Seedy Jobe
